layer.name: Music communities
layer.description: This shows where music groups are located across Australia which are open to older adults
layer.creator: Helen English

properties.name: Avoca U3A
properties.description: Avoca U3A is a voluntary Seniors Group providing educational, recreational and social programs to people in their third age of life (those of us who are retired or are semi-retired)

extended_data.Address: cnr Thomas and Summers St, Avoca VIC3467

properties.name: Maryborough Community House Ukulele Group
properties.description: Reasonably simple chords. Key of C, G,D. Popular songs from 50s to 80s. Beatles and folk songs.

properties.name: Elwood Community Choir
properties.description: Come and have some fun singing in your own local choir! No auditions, all welcome. World music, music by Australian artists, pop, and more. Community gigs

properties.name: Blackalls Swing Band
properties.description: jazz band

properties.name: LakeMac Ukestra
properties.description: ukulele group for retirees

properties.name: St John of God caregiver chorus
properties.description: Caregiver Chorus, which is made up of staff, volunteers and community members.

properties.name: Mugi Rahayu
properties.description: Mugi Rahayu, Central Victoria's only gamelan ensemble, is a community group who practice and perform traditional Indonesian music and dance. Based in Bendigo, we perform throughout Victoria and always encourage new people to become involved in Indonesian culture through playing and dancing with us, no previous experience required

properties.name: Kyneton Street Band
properties.description: The Kyneton Street Band Inc's purpose is to provide a vibrant outdoor band experience for the Macedon Ranges and surrounding district communities. The band features marimbas, wind, brass and percussion instruments in a unique mobile format, made possible by the creation of marching marimbas. Membership is open to people of all ages, and the selection of music played and the marimbas in particular, make the band accessible to musicians of limited experience, as well as seasoned professionals and amateurs

properties.name: Scotso Surf Coast Old Time Street Orchestra
properties.description: We are an old time street orchestra in the Surf Coast area. The aim is to get people together to play for fun, learn some American and Celtic folk tunes with possibly some Swing or other genres of tunes and maybe at some stage to do some performances in our local communities.

properties.name: Castlemaine Peace Choir
properties.description: We are a community choir formed in a partnership between Castlemaine Community House, Windarring, St Lukes and Maine Connection.  We are an unauditioned, mixed abilities choir that meets weekly and sings joyful and heart-warming songs that build a sense of belonging and self empowerment

properties.name: Bendigo Symphony Orchestra
properties.description: The orchestra presents four concerts each year featuring a range of local, national, and international artists. The BSO has been a strong advocate of local composers, giving a number of premieres of new works.

properties.name: The Dorkestra
properties.description: Having played quite a few tunes together over the years, the Dorks are now a proud, intermediate and advanced level group of adult string and woodwind players.We play an eclectic mix of western art music and popular hits. Our current favourites include Bach Brandenburg No.3 in G as well as Bach Suite No.3 in D.

properties.name: The Awkwardstra
properties.description: The Awkwardstra, or Awks as we are more commonly known, was established in 2014 as an eclectic group consisting of a couple of violins, a viola, a saxophone, even a harmonica and has now settled into an ever growing strings and woodwind chamber group (complete with Harp.We are always welcoming of new players and regularly perform at Sunday markets and for family and friends.

properties.name: HUG Hobart Ukulele Group
properties.description: HUG is a friendly group of happy uke players that are meeting every Mon night.Even if you’ve never played a ukulele, or any musical instrument, before you’ll be made very welcome at HUG. And the speed with which you learn to play a song or two will surprise and delight you.

properties.name: Melbourne ukulele community
properties.description: This group is for ukulele beginners who want to strum and sing along with their ukuleles. Sessions are free donations welcomed and we have spare ukuleles. We play about 15 songs per session, ranging from easy to medium difficulty.

properties.name: Barrier Industrial Unions Brass Band
properties.description: Broken Hill is a mining city in outback Western NSW with a long tradition of community brass banding since 1884. The BIU Band is the sole remaining brass band in the city. Currently we are involved in many community activities throughout the year. We welcome new members and visitors and have tuition available and instruments for hire for anyone wanting to join the band and learn a brass instrument.

properties.name: Broken Hill Philharmonic Choir
properties.placename: Aged Persons Rest Centre, 254 Blende St, Broken Hill
properties.description: We are a mixed choir presenting 3 concerts per year to the public of Broken Hill we love to sing. Available also for community events.

properties.name: U3A singing group
properties.placename: Paddy O'Donoghue Center, 18 Buckley St Noble Park, 3174
properties.description: U3A singing group

properties.name: Glee West
properties.description: Glee West is a singing group that rehearse in 10 week seasons towards a performance. The group only require you to be willing to do a bit of practice each week. Glee West rehearsals include a tea break known as Wine Time

extended_data.Address: Kindred Studios, 3 Harris Street, Yarraville VIC 3013

properties.name: Glee Plus
properties.description: Glee Plus is a choir group that works in short seasons towards a performance. The commitment is only a couple months at a time. The group is face paced, and get through approximately four songs per rehearsal.

extended_data.Address: The Malthouse, 113 Sturt Street, Southbank VIC 3006
extended_data.Cost: $500 including trip or $240 if you elect not to take the trip

properties.name: Song Club
properties.description: Song Club works by learning select songs prior to the rehearsal time across a range of styles and difficulties. You are encouraged to pick a song or two to learn each week. The group then meets once a week where everyone can perform their songs in front of a group.

extended_data.Address: Online via zoom and some meetings in Melbourne

properties.name: THE CHOIR
properties.description: One of Melbourne’s most dynamic and largest community adult choirs. THECHO!R aspires to the highest choral standards whilst supporting community based activities. THECHO!R is open to all singers.

properties.name: Victorian Trade Union Choir
properties.description: The victorian trade union choir is a singing group where members are expected to be a trade union member or a retired union member or unemployed and previously a union member.

properties.name: Melbourne Mass Gospel Choir
properties.description: 80 voice community gospel choir singing a broad range of gospel, soul and related musical styles.

properties.name: Royal Melbourne Philharmonic Society Inc
properties.description: Major symphonic chorus and professional symphonic orchestra. Audition only, but professional training is not required.

extended_data.Day: Every Tuesday choir and Orchestra Friday/Sunday as needed

properties.name: Choir Coral Canta Mais
properties.description: Brazilian Choir that sings diverse Brazilian rhythms from MPB to Samba. The choir mainly sings in Portuguese.

properties.name: All Girls Jam
properties.description: AGJ provides an encouraging, supportive and exciting environment. We encourage singers, poets, instrumentalists of all kinds in a range of genres, dancers, stand-up comedians  - all from different ages and stages.

extended_data.Day: Bimonthly on the first Friday of the month

properties.name: Chao Feng Chinese Orchestra
properties.description: Largest and longest running Chinese Orchestra in Australia.

properties.name: Ozanam Community Centre/Quinn House music and song writing therapy groups
properties.description: This group focuses on working as a team, harmony singing, basic music theory and the development of interpersonal skills within a music medium.

properties.name: Astra Music
properties.description: Presents classical and contemporary choral and chamber instrumental works with an emphasis on Australian compositions. Regularly commissions new work. Must be able to read music. Audition only.

properties.name: Fancy Yourself Fiddling
properties.description: Fiddle teacher; Sean Kenan has people playing fiddle in record time; no musical experience required, just a love of Irish music.

properties.name: Play like a girl
properties.description: Aims to provide an opportunity for female musicians to network, gain inspiration and support from each other; encourage women of all ages to develop and maintain viable and rewarding careers in music.

properties.name: Melbourne Sinfonia
properties.description: One of Melbourne's best non-professional symphony orchestras. If you are an advanced player or a semi-professional or even professional musician considering joining the Melbourne Sinfonia, we'd like to hear from you.
